items.markdown:
![Vegan Thai Green Curry | Munching with Mariyah](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07280349-1672-0139-0000-2e147030e753:6)
Thai green curry (*gaeng khiew waan* ) is `a popular, vibrant Thai dish made with a rich coconut milk base and fresh green chilies` . It typically includes tender chicken or beef, Thai eggplant, bamboo shoots, and fresh herbs, offering a flavorful balance of spicy, savory, and subtly sweet notes.[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Green_curry) [[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Green_curry)[[2]](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/green-curry-new-2/)[[3]](https://www.seriouseats.com/gaeng-khiao-waan-gai-thai-green-curry-with-chicken-recipe-5189726)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/zPkOPx1Oelw)

The Curry Paste

The foundation of the dish is its signature green curry paste. The bright color and heat primarily come from fresh, young green chilies. The paste is traditionally ground using a mortar and pestle with a fragrant blend of:[](https://rainbowplantlife.com/vegan-thai-green-curry/) [[1]](https://rainbowplantlife.com/vegan-thai-green-curry/)[[2]](https://www.cottagedelight.co.uk/blog/whats-the-difference-between-red-and-green-thai-curry/)

- **Lemongrass:** Gives a citrusy, aromatic flavor.
- **Galangal:** An earthy, piney rhizome similar to ginger.
- **Makrut (Kaffir) Lime:** Both the zest and leaves are used for an intense, zesty citrus scent.
- **Garlic and Shallots:** For a savory foundation.
- **Shrimp Paste (or fermented fish sauce):** Provides deep umami.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7K0S0vTIS9A) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7K0S0vTIS9A)[[2]](http://www.thaiorganics.co.th/organics-vegetable/)[[3]](https://www.redlemonthai.com.au/post/exploring-the-flavors-of-thailand-a-guide-to-thai-cuisine)

Flavor Profile & Preparation While the literal translation of *gaeng kiew waan* means "sweet green curry," the sweetness refers to the pastel green color of the dish rather than a sugary taste.[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Green_curry) The cooking process typically begins by reducing the thicker, creamy part of canned coconut milk until it separates and the natural coconut oils release. The green curry paste is then fried in these oils to release its aromatics. Afterward, the protein, the rest of the coconut milk, and vegetables (like pea or Thai eggplant) are simmered until tender. The dish is finished with a squeeze of lime juice, a splash of fish sauce, palm sugar, and a generous handful of fresh Thai basil.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1TLgGyWOSsk&t=566) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1TLgGyWOSsk&t=566)[[2]](https://www.loveandlemons.com/thai-green-curry/)Serving Thai green curry is traditionally served alongside steamed jasmine rice or thin rice noodles.[](https://www.recipetineats.com/thai-green-curry/) [[1]](https://www.recipetineats.com/thai-green-curry/)[[2]](https://www.flyinggoosebrand.com/the-health-benefits-of-green-curry/)For a visual guide on the traditional method of frying the curry paste in coconut cream to build maximum flavor:![Related video thumbnail](https://encrypted-tbn2.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcSK4RwQw1y5deNm9bYrpLt6Kv6PdAh4DxOMD2bdwy5m8SotpsY3)
